name: Seeed XIAO 7.5" ePaper Panel (C3, TRMNL BYOS)
description: Seeed's integrated XIAO 7.5 inch ePaper Panel (ESP32-C3 on board) running the XIAO TRMNL firmware variant, so it speaks Tesserae's TRMNL BYOS endpoints. Same hardware as xiao_epaper_panel_75_c3; pick that kind instead when the unit runs the Tesserae-native firmware.
notes_md: Confirmed on real hardware running the XIAO TRMNL firmware. The XIAO TRMNL firmware sends its MAC in the Id header (uppercase, colon-separated); Tesserae's BYOS layer matches case-insensitively, no extra configuration needed.
